description: Source code for 'HeyGenClient', a Python class providing integration with the HeyGen platform for creating conversational AI applications with avatars. It manages real-time avatar streaming, WebSocket and LiveKit connections, and handles avatar control, audio/video streaming, and participant events within the Pipecat framework.

classes.name: ServiceType
classes.description: Enumeration for specifying the type of HeyGen service (Interactive Avatar or Live Avatar).

classes.name: HeyGenCallbacks
classes.description: Data class defining callback handler functions for participant connection and disconnection events.

classes.name: HeyGenClient
classes.description: Main class managing connection, communication, and streaming with the HeyGen platform for avatar-based AI applications.
